script.speaker: doctor
script.text: Hi there! I'm Dr. Martinez. What brings you in today?

script.speaker: parent
script.text: Hi doctor. My son Jake has this wart on his finger that's been bothering him.

script.speaker: doctor
script.text: Let me take a look at that finger, Jake. Can you show me which one?

script.speaker: child
script.text: This one right here. It hurts when I touch it.

script.speaker: doctor
script.text: I can see it's on your index finger. How long has this been there?

script.speaker: parent
script.text: About three weeks now. It started small but seems to be getting bigger.

script.speaker: doctor
script.text: Has he had any other warts before or anyone in the family with warts recently?

script.speaker: parent
script.text: No, this is the first one. His sister had one last year but it went away on its own.

script.speaker: doctor
script.text: Jake, does it hurt when you use your hands for writing or playing?

script.speaker: child
script.text: Sometimes when I write it bumps on my pencil.

script.speaker: doctor
script.text: This is definitely a common wart. It's caused by a virus and is very treatable.

script.speaker: parent
script.text: What are our options for treatment?

script.speaker: doctor
script.text: We can try over-the-counter wart medicine first or freeze it here in the office. The freezing works faster.

script.speaker: doctor
script.text: It stings for just a few seconds, like putting ice on your skin. You're brave enough to handle it.

script.speaker: parent
script.text: Let's try the freezing treatment today if that's what you recommend.

script.speaker: doctor
script.text: Perfect. I'll get the supplies and we'll take care of this right now.
